items.title: Mrs. Francis Oliver Interview, 1969-05-10
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] When did you... that was Victor Koloss. Yeah, Koloss. Is that what you pronounce the name? Yes, Koloss. He looked just like a Frenchman, too. [INTERVIEWEE] He looked like a white man. In fact, that's how my mother looked.

ctx.x: Oh, yeah, he got well, and I mean, he was able to take care of my sister and her husband, because he... my sister had an appendectomy, and her husband had lung removed, and he was taking care of that.
When did you... that was Victor Koloss. Yeah, Koloss. Is that what you pronounce the name? Yes, Koloss. He looked just like a Frenchman, too.
He looked like a white man. In fact, that's how my mother looked.
